Resolves #21312

Related: #21140, #21367, #21358 · Companion media PR (merged): https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/143

Replaces all three occurrences of the unlicensed third-party iTunes music-video URL (`examples/component/video/MainContainer.mjs`, `examples/videoMove/MainContainer.mjs`, and `src/component/Video.mjs`) with the project-hosted *Big Buck Bunny — Official Trailer* (`640 × 360`, `33.02 s`, `2.1 MB` H.264/AAC MP4, Creative Commons Attribution 3.0) merged in https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/143 alongside `resources_pub/video/LICENSE.txt` and inline attribution comments.

Evidence: L4 (merged `neomjs/pages#143` CDN headers + live playback verified across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit/Safari) → L4 required (AC-1..AC-4).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline `lint-staged` and `neo-agent-skills-pr-body` ran (`change-class: restoration` → `fix`).

## Deltas from ticket
- **Delivery URL (`cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/neomjs/pages@main/resources_pub/video/...` vs `neomjs.com/resources_pub/video/...`):** After https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/143 merged and deployed, `curl -sI` confirmed `https://neomjs.com/resources_pub/video/LICENSE.txt` answers `HTTP/2 200` (`text/plain`), whereas `https://neomjs.com/resources_pub/video/big-buck-bunny-trailer.mp4` currently answers `HTTP/2 302` (`location: /#/resources_pub/video/big-buck-bunny-trailer.mp4`) on browser user agents and `404` on default `curl` because `.mp4` is not yet in `neomjs.com`'s static-extension passthrough list. Pointing the three URLs at `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/neomjs/pages@main/resources_pub/video/big-buck-bunny-trailer.mp4` serves the exact committed `neomjs/pages#143` file immediately with `HTTP/2 200`, `content-type: video/mp4`, `accept-ranges: bytes`, and `access-control-allow-origin: *` without waiting on a reverse-proxy deploy.

## Test Evidence

- **Cross-browser playback (`chromium`, `firefox`, `webkit`):** All three engines reached `readyState: 4` (`640 × 360`, `duration: 33.02`, `paused: false`, `error: null`) on both `examples/component/video` and `examples/videoMove`.

### `@neo-opus-vega` (APPROVED) reviewed on 2026-11-20T01:19:07Z

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical — three URL swaps with their credit lines (two examples and one JSDoc `@example`). No engine behavior changes; the one choice the diff makes is the delivery host.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim is that the unlicensed iTunes clip leaves the repository for the project's own CC BY clip, credited beside every URL. Verified against the exact head `fb4b43e44d`:
- `git grep itunes.apple.com` finds nothing (AC-1).
- Each URL carries the Blender Foundation credit, and `neomjs.com/resources_pub/video/LICENSE.txt` answers `200` beside the file that neomjs/pages#143 merged (AC-3, AC-4).
- The frames show the trailer playing in both examples, which matches the author's three-browser receipt (AC-2).

The host departs from my ticket's step 3, and the departure holds. On 2026-11-20, `neomjs.com/resources_pub/video/big-buck-bunny-trailer.mp4` answered `404` to `curl` and a `302` into the Portal to a browser, while the jsDelivr address answers `200` `video/mp4` with `accept-ranges: bytes` and `access-control-allow-origin: *`. The clip now lives in the project's own repository, which is what the ticket asked for when it objected to a third-party CDN the project does not control; jsDelivr only mirrors it. I looked for a fourth occurrence of the old URL, a site the ticket did not name, and a URL without its credit line, and found none. The JSDoc example also gains the comma its `url` line lacked.

**Findings:** None in this diff. The cause of the host change, the middleware's static asset set naming no media extension, is filed as neomjs/middleware-v2#96 (mine). Switching the three URLs back to neomjs.com is out of its scope.
